review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. smart-base.js and loader.js, the two files the lessons are read against, are byte-identical to the last review. Smart moved for two reasons: component rules now load every Smart element their templates render, and ARIA moved to where it is read -- named select boxes, icon tabs named on the inner button, sf-checkbox gaining ariaLabel. Neither changes an attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference the lessons teach, so none of the eight lessons changes.
